summary: On April 23, 2026, Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a Subscription Agreement to acquire 8,163,265 shares of Vivasor, Inc. Series A Common Stock at $6.125/share, totaling $50 million. Consideration is entirely non-cash: Datavault will issue 75,942,666 shares of its common stock to Vivasor. The Datavault Shares are being registered under an existing shelf S-3. The acquisition appears structured as a stock-for-stock exchange with no cash component. The filing is an asset acquisition; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for shareholder approval requirements and regulatory clearance; the risk-arb angle centers on relative valuation of the two stocks.
